items.explanation: A shared result points to a chance for a child. It is not a diagnosis of either partner, and it is not a ruling on a marriage.
A carrier has one changed copy of a gene. Most carriers have no symptoms.
The chart is out of 100 pregnancies. It describes the chance for a pregnancy. It does not say how many children you will have.
The choice is yours. A counsellor explains the choices that exist and does not tell you what to decide.
A counsellor can explain the result and the choices. Screening is done at licensed centres, not at home.

results_note: Your answers are shown with a short explanation. There is no cut-off.
scoring_note: Deterministic: one point for each answer equal to the key, out of five. Not-sure and blank answers score zero and are reported as such. There is no cut-off and no verdict.
